title: Add legacy score/section index compatibility for local dashboard MVP
description: Support legacy listScoreByScorecardIdAndOrder and listScorecardSectionByScorecardIdAndOrder roots in local mode so scorecards dashboard can render scores/sections against the local control plane.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented synthetic legacy index-root fallback in services/private-graphql-proxy/proxy/schema_contract.py for local mode query roots of the form list<Model>By<Partition>And<Sort> when those fields exist on the model. This enables dashboard roots like listScoreByScorecardIdAndOrder and listScorecardSectionByScorecardIdAndOrder even when not present in current manifest indexes. Added regression coverage in test_operation_classifier.py and test_app_routing.py; dockerized proxy tests pass; live GraphQL checks now return seeded scorecard sections/scores/score versions for legacy root names.
